prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, approach it, take it if necessary, perform task, else scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDesignatedLocation    /> <Action ID = CarryObjectCarefully    /> <Action ID = ContainObjectToPreventPollution    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInRange    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectFragile    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectPolluting    /> <SubTree ID = PerformTask    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO ApproachObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectInRange? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDesignatedLocation
	ELSE
		DO PerformTask
	END
